queries.query: EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Production Planning - Legacy'[Date], 'Production Planning - Legacy'[Plant #], 'Production Planning - Legacy'[Product Line ID], 'Production Planning - Legacy'[Estimated Production])
EVALUATE FILTER(SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Production Planning - Legacy'[Estimated Production]), NOT ISBLANK('Production Planning - Legacy'[Estimated Production]))
EVALUATE FILTER(SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Production Planning - Legacy'[Date]), NOT ISBLANK('Production Planning - Legacy'[Date]))
